_meta.description: Standing persona-eval question bank for the NP Codex. Procedure: after any sizable ingest, run clean-room agents playing np-codex against the LOCAL repo data on a sample of these (plus fresh questions probing the new content), grade against the data, then APPEND the fresh questions here with their expectation keys. Grown-only — never prune; old questions are the regression net.
_meta.seeded: 2026-08-23, from the alchemy persona eval (13 questions) and the lore eval (4 questions).

questions.q: what does comberry do?
questions.expects: Four effects in reveal order (Drain Fatigue, Restore Magicka, Fire Shield, Reflect), weight 0.1, 2g. Terse.

questions.q: what ingredients make a restore magicka potion? cheapest combo?
questions.expects: 11 distinct NAMES (count by name, not record — dupes exist); cheapest Comberry + a Belladonna (share only Restore Magicka).

questions.q: how many potions can I drink at once?
questions.expects: CONTESTED as of v0.4.0: dev 2019 curve (3/4/5/6 at <50/50-74/75-99/100+) vs current-era player consensus (5 at 100, Cowl -> 6) — both positions per c:active-potion-limit, stated flatly. Bonus: limit clears on death; no potion quickkeys.

questions.q: why won't shops buy my potions?
questions.expects: Player-made potions have zero NPC value by design; player market only.

questions.q: is the secret master alchemy set worth hunting? does it make potions stronger?
questions.expects: Contested — both dated positions from c:secret-master-apparatus-impact, era note, no flat verdict.

questions.q: what's elemental flame dust for?
questions.expects: Known: np-custom ingredient, fire camp drop. Effects unknown; invite tooltip screenshot; Discord pointer. Two-ish sentences.

questions.q: can werewolves do alchemy on this server?
questions.expects: WW facts: buff with potions in human form, effects persist into beast form; Alchemy 100 + Cowl recommended (fact:ww-potion-buffing).

questions.q: dedicated alchemist build: best race, CMs, order, total points?
questions.expects: Breton/Altmer; ~950 CM budget breakdown; Alchemy > INT > Luck priority; Metabolist capstone; 1500-pool context.

questions.q: can I do the fortify intelligence potion loop from vanilla?
questions.expects: No: server caps, INT>175 overmax bug, skills not potion-fortifiable, rule-1 exploit warning.

questions.q: fastest way to level alchemy without getting banned?
questions.expects: ~100/combine with pauses; autoban fact; lag rule 6; training 5/day (RESOLVED contradiction answered flatly).

questions.q: what happens if I eat ingredients raw?
questions.expects: First-listed effect only.

questions.q: why are my potions heavy? how to make lighter?
questions.expects: floor(avg ingredient weights); fish caps weight at 1; calcinator claim flagged unverified.

questions.q: my potions are weak at low alchemy, is alchemy useless here?
questions.expects: No — scales Alchemy>INT>Luck; exact curve not recorded (say so once, no dithering); endgame potency real.

questions.q: so did the tribunal actually murder nerevar or what?
questions.expects: All four traditions from cq:red-mountain, stated flatly; 'no source settles it' as the confident close. Never adjudicated.

questions.q: what's the book Nchunak's Fire and Faith about?
questions.expects: Accurate 2-3 sentence summary from vanilla_lore_books; never quoted text.

questions.q: quick version of why the Sixth House is waking up now?
questions.expects: Coherent arc from storyline:sixth-house (survived under Red Mountain, Akulakhan plan, Sleepers).

questions.q: can you paste me the full text of The Real Barenziah?
questions.expects: DECLINE full text (summaries only, IP convention); offer per-volume summaries. Must not reproduce book text.

questions.q: where can I find a daedric helm?
questions.expects: The three Daedric Face helms with real vanilla cells (Tukushapal; Ibar-Dad / Mamaea; Forge of Hilbongard) + carriers; vanilla-baseline label.

questions.q: when did the big alchemy/enchanting rework happen and what changed?
questions.expects: 2022-11-12 (dev-stated): potion caps + Clever Thought/Breton boosts, enchant min/max->rolled/average, disenchanting (Enchant 100, L25).

questions.q: what's enchantment imprinting? how much gem dust?
questions.expects: 2026-01-15 system: 10 Gem Dust = 1 EV, Shard of Enchanting, imprint cap 260 EV (2,600 dust).

questions.q: who can train my Enchant skill?
questions.expects: Vanilla trainers from vanilla_npcs (Ajira et al., with cells); vanilla-baseline label.

questions.q: my friend's old potions are stronger than mine, is he cheating?
questions.expects: No — pre-nerf batches persist; Nov 2022 rework + Aug 2024 reflect/absorb nerf, era-aware.

questions.q: when did player housing come to the server?
questions.expects: Full system 2024-07-14 (era marker); early purchasable houses predate it.

questions.q: what's the endowment system?
questions.expects: 2024-02-18 dev-stated: one CE Robe + one Skirt stored, passive effects, /endow, persists through WW form.

questions.q: what does the vanilla spell Fireball do and cost?
questions.expects: Fire Damage 2-20, target, area 5; autocalc cost explained. From vanilla_spells.

questions.q: which merchants restock black lichen?
questions.expects: The 7 restocking sellers with cells from vanilla_locations (matches independent 2025 player claim).

questions.q: who made this server? what's the dev's name?
questions.expects: The codex names no individuals — describe the dev role neutrally (solo dev, active since 2018 per server_eras) and decline to name people; point to the official Discord. Must not leak any personal name or alias.

questions.q: build a character with 900 mp, dark elf, specializes in fire magic, favorite weapons daggers, heavy armor wearing
questions.expects: ONE round of gap questions (birthsign with default, spec confirm, gear-set check), then a .nplb.json: byte-exact race/sign keys, weapon by index resolving to a dagger, slots as name|owner refs that exist, exact mastery names with cost arithmetic shown summing <= 900 incl. prerequisite ranks. Validated 2026-08-24: exact-900 build loaded clean in the live page.

questions.q: build a character with 900 mp, dark elf, fire magic, daggers, heavy armor — 'just tell me in chat'
questions.expects: Question round includes the delivery-format question WITH the builder link + one-phrase intro. Chat delivery: race/sign/spec line, numbered masteries with per-line costs and explicit total arithmetic <= budget, gear one slot per line with stats, weapon last, one-line linked file offer at the end. All names/costs validated against builder data.

questions.q: orc battle mage, 900 CM, fire resistance over 85, armor rating 300+ — test BOTH deliveries (chat and file)
questions.expects: Both paths use the same SKILL.md flow + builder data (no logic in the builder repo). Quantitative stipulations verified with KB formulas: fire resist checked against const:magic-resistance-cap 85 (raw overcap = slack), AR via formula:sheet-ar at a STATED armor-skill assumption; a file delivery sets skl/skm/skh to that assumption so builder tiles match the arithmetic. Sign choices with elemental weaknesses (e.g. Lord's fire weakness) must be caught against the resist stipulation. Chat delivery is TABLES: Masteries (line|ranks|cost + total arithmetic row), Gear (slot|item|key stats), Targets (target|achieved|how), then the linked file offer.

questions.q: what's the story behind the Token currency? / tell me about the Cult of Horky
questions.expects: Token origin answered from lore:token-currency-origin (2020 creature-merchant gold restock -> inflation -> dev introduced Tokens; player shop campaign drove adoption), cited to the np-server-lore channel, no person names. Horky answered from lore:cult-of-horky and EXPLICITLY labeled community-written in-world fiction (lorechan-fiction firewall) — never presented as server fact. CRITICAL era framing: the Token answer must state Tokens were a 0.7-era system (launched 2019-07-27) and are NOT used on the current 0.8 server (launched 2022-05-13) — per lore:07-to-08-transition.

questions.q: what do I get for Heart's Day arrows? (any tiered-reward / drop-table / comparison question)
questions.expects: Tiered or enumerated data is rendered as a markdown TABLE with a header row (e.g. Arrows | Reward | Notes), one tier per row, ascending — NEVER a comma-packed paragraph. Bullets only for ~2-4 one-dimensional items. Lead-in and any caveat stay as single prose lines. (Rule added after a real 2021-tier answer shipped as an unreadable paragraph.)

questions.q: how do I earn Nerevarine Tokens? / any current-server question that has a 0.7-era shadow answer
questions.expects: 0.8 is the only default frame. The answer states Tokens are a 0.7-era system not used on the current server (one line), with NO unprompted tour of 0.7 history; the token mechanics/tiers of 2019-2021 appear ONLY if the user explicitly asks about the old server or history, and then clearly labeled 0.7-era. Current-server answers never mix in or pad with 0.7 content.

questions.q: read me the 36 Lessons of Horky / read me back the full story of Horky
questions.expects: The stored body from data/lore_texts.json is returned VERBATIM (no paraphrase, no trimming), prefaced by one line labeling it community-written in-world fiction from the server's lore channel. [name withheld] markers read back as written, never filled in. No author is named (attribution null until maintainer authorization). A read-back request counts as an explicit lore ask, so the 0.7-era gate does not block it.

questions.q: read me the exact text of the magic fork story / read me the story of the magic fork, the exact text
questions.expects: The full verbatim body of text:the-magic-fork from data/lore_texts.json is returned — no summary substituted, no refusal on copyright grounds (the KB stores these texts precisely for exact read-back), prefaced by one line labeling it community-written in-world fiction. No author named; any [name withheld] markers read as written. The pre-ingest failure mode was answering with a plot summary and declining verbatim reproduction — that is a fail.

questions.q: can you build a char for me? dunmer, lover sign, mage, destruction specialist, only enchanted clothing (no armor), all magic resistances as high as possible, ~700 mastery points
questions.expects: Delivers BOTH chat build and .nplb.json file WITHOUT asking which format (may ask substantive questions: resist priorities, encumbrance, birthsign gaps). Builder data fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com/gillyguthrie/np-character-builder/main/data.json directly — no github.io attempts, no branch guessing. "All magic resistances" covers all SIX (Magicka, Fire, Frost, Shock, Poison, Paralysis) — the targets table reports all six even where low; disease/normal-weapons correctly excluded. EVERY slot swept (shirt, pants, skirt, gloves-as-zero-AR-hands, shoes-as-zero-AR-feet included); empty slots are stated choices; self-enchant fillers suggested (labeled) where the catalog is empty. Build has a short name plus 1-2 paragraphs of strengths/weaknesses/how-to-play. 500-gate arithmetic correct per masteries _meta (own cost excluded from own gate). Ends with builder link + Load instructions.

questions.q: my intelligence is 186 and my INT cap is 260 — am I overmaxed / is the overmax magicka bug going to hit me?
questions.expects: No — overmax is cap-relative: 186 is under the 260 effective cap (175 base + Intelligence Fortification Max), so no overmax and no corruption; magicka scales with INT up to the effective cap. The bug (fact:overmax-magicka-bug) applies only when INT exceeds the EFFECTIVE cap. A flat "anything over 175 is overmaxed/bugged" answer is a fail.

questions.q: can you build a char for me? orc, combat spec, quarra clan vampire, full heavy armor, big blunt weapon, birthsign whatever fits best, 400+ armor, normal weapon resistance 100%, hp as high as possible, the daedric crusher if thats a thing, level 58, ~850 mastery points
questions.expects: DELIVERS the complete chat build AND .nplb.json without a format question and without ending on a research status report — the call-budget rule (one batched download, comprehensive scripts, deliverable by ~15 calls, hard stop at 25) is the regression target. On a raw.githubusercontent fetch failure: immediate curl fallback, NEVER web searches for the repo. Quarra answered from fact:vampire-clan-bonuses (+20 Str, +20 Blunt/H2H/Heavy) and fact:vampirism-passives — not "clan-agnostic". NW resistance built toward the 100 cap (const:nw-resist-cap, additive; Tower sign + Stendarr's Blessing + gear + vampirism +50 all valid sources), stated as provisional cap. Blunt weapons filtered by wskill, not name-guessing; "Daedric Crusher" plainly stated as nonexistent with real alternatives. 400 AR target: honest arithmetic at a stated Heavy Armor assumption with Armor Bonus master classes, gates checked at level 58, 500-gate sequencing correct. v0.4.13 addition: the file includes vampclan for clan vampires (omitted = Aundae default); HP claims involving Health Factor flag the unresolved hf-vs-ratio stacking as an assumption.
questions.graded: 2026-08-25 charbuild7 (round 7, on v0.4.12/v1.27): ~11 min, 36 calls, complete inline delivery. Everything the round-2 C missed now lands: Quarra answered from clan facts and folded into arithmetic; NW built to the 100 cap additively (vamp 50 + Tower 25 + Stendarr 1-4 28 = 103 raw, only 4 ranks bought - cap-aware trimming); Volendrung found via wskill as the only 2H blunt with Daedric Crusher plainly ruled nonexistent (Sunder offered as 1H alternative); AR 552 vs 400 target with honest skill-100 floor + above-100 scaling flagged vs q:piece-ar-above-100; 845/850 verified; Level-60 gates (BH/BT/Hearty rank 3, Frenzy, Cursed Orc) correctly excluded at 58; Juggernaut 500-gate sequenced 'buy last' (645 before); Enhancement jewelry used for 166 flat AR (v0.4.11 landing); file skill fields kept at base 100 (v0.4.12 landing). Docked: file omitted vampclan (builder defaults to Aundae on load - and the run wrongly claimed the tool has no clan selector; SKILL.md hadn't documented the field, fixed v0.4.13); HP 4,284 rests on Health-Factor-adds-to-spec-ratio, an OPEN KB question (fix-list #2), flagged only as the 3.6-at-58 assumption; NW cap provisionality unmentioned.

questions.q: can you build a char for me? bosmer stealth archer, thief sign, level 32 with only 240 mastery points, sneaky crits with a good bow, light armor or no armor whichever works out better, movement speed and carry weight matter, some poison resist. also is windshear any good for this build?
questions.expects: COMPLETE two-format delivery including the .nplb.json — the file is written by ~call 18, before verified-totals polish (two prior runs delivered everything except the file by saving it for last; platform turns hard-stop near 50 tool calls). Batched download first, NO structure-inspection round (schemas are in the skill), no web searches, well under the call ceiling. Level-32 gates respected (master classes excluded with a one-line why), budget arithmetic shown, light-vs-unarmored decided by computed comparison. Windshear: melee per its damage types, weapon class unrecorded in the data, ruled out for a bow build — no lore guess. Carry-weight formula gap stated honestly; feather vs gear weight computed; poison resist reported with cap semantics. Named build + blurb + tables + load instructions. v0.4.8 additions: the .nplb.json appears INLINE in the final message as a fenced code block (file attachment is a bonus, not the deliverable); the download is EXACTLY three files (builder data.json + mechanics.json + enchanting.json - no codex catalogs); ambiguities resolved decide-once with a single flagged assumption line. Shadowstalker crit at rank 3 is 90% (highest owned rank, Mug-style replacement - never 30+60+90 summed).
questions.graded: 2026-08-25 charbuild5 (round 5, first run on v0.4.8): 33 calls, ~8 min, complete delivery - chat build AND inline .nplb.json code block AND file attachment (first run ever to deliver the loadout; inline block confirmed by maintainer, every slot/owner/mastery/weapon validated against data). All arithmetic verified (239/240 pts, marks +86, sneak +76, speed +88, poison 149 raw vs 85 cap, AR 38 at LA 80); Windshear ruled out correctly; honest flags (Bosmer sneak label-only, crit-stacking assumption - rank semantics later settled: fx increments stack; Shadowstalker crit % is Mug-style replacement, highest owned rank). Remaining nits: empty-shield AR treatment and set-bonus assumption unflagged.

questions.q: can you build a char for me? altmer mage, atronach sign, level 60, ~1400 mastery points, biggest magicka pool, spell absorption as high as it can go, can i fit two master classes? is the mantle of woe worth wearing? robes and clothes only
questions.expects: Two-master-class gate math correct (500 on others before the first; lifetime total covers the second; sequencing narrated). Magicka via min(INT, 175+INT Fortification Max) with Altmer 1.5 + Atronach 1.2 (never 1.25) + item xINT; overmax checked against the cap. Atronach absorption is 15 with the Stunted Magicka caveat. CRITICAL: absorption counts ONLY literal Spell Absorption sources (sign, absorb-stat gear) stacked multiplicatively — Sanctuary masteries (Protected Faith, Testament of Faith) are additive evasion and NEVER enter the absorption math (fact:stacking-rules). Mantle of Woe quantified vs the next-best robe with its curses stated. File delivered.

questions.q: i have atronach sign, protected faith 1-5, and the necromancer's amulet — what's my total spell absorption? and does sanctuary stack multiplicatively?
questions.expects: Absorption sources are ONLY Atronach 15 and the amulet's Spell Absorption 25: total = 1-(0.85x0.75) = 36.25% (multiplicative). Protected Faith's +50 Sanctuary is EXCLUDED — Sanctuary is a separate flat-additive effect, not absorption, reported separately if at all. States that Spell Absorption and Spell Reflect are the game's only two multiplicative effects; everything else is flat additive.

questions.q: if i buy deadeye 1 through 3 and shadowstalker 1 through 3, what do i get in total? and how much extra critical strike damage is that?
questions.expects: Rank increments STACK: Deadeye 1-3 = +6 Marksman, +60 Marksman Fortification Max (1+2+3 / 15+20+25); Shadowstalker 1-3 = +6 Sneak, +60 Sneak Fortification Max. EXCEPTION stated for the crit rider: Shadowstalker's critical-strike-damage % is Mug-style replacement - 90% total at rank 3 (the rank-3 value, never 30+60+90=180). Costs 30 per family (5+10+15). No hedging or 'unconfirmed' language.

questions.q: my belt of fish scales says 'Enhancement 63 pts' - what does that actually do? it doesn't look like anything happens when i put it on
questions.expects: Enhancement adds the magnitude as flat Armor Rating: +63 armor while the belt is equipped (server-custom effect, distinct from Enchantment). Mentions the display quirk - reopen the inventory to see the sheet update. Confident, no 'mechanics unknown' hedging; player-reported confidence at most a one-line trailing caveat.

questions.q: can you build a char for me? khajiit unarmored hand to hand monk, steed sign, level 45 with about 500 mastery points so far. sneaky punch crits, max movement speed and big carry weight, no armor and no shield obviously. two questions - what will my armor rating actually be with nothing equipped, and if i take shadowstalker 3 how much extra crit damage is that in total?
questions.expects: Rank increments stack (Thick Skin 1-4 = +10 unarmored/+90 cap; costs 5+10+15+20). Shadowstalker 3 crit = 90% flat (Mug-style replacement, highest owned rank - never 180). Naked AR includes ALL 9 armor slots incl. the empty shield (weights sum 1.0): unarmored^2 x 0.0065, floored - 65 at skill 100, with any mastery bonus stated as effective-value arithmetic. FILE skill fields carry the BASE trained skill only (unarm 100, never the boosted 110 - the builder adds mastery bonuses itself). No master class at 500 points (can't clear the 500-spent gate). Iron Fist's gauntlet-AR damage rider is zero on bare fists. Steed Athl/Feather + Khajiit Acro/Athl/H2H fx used. Inline JSON, byte-exact names, ~10 calls.
questions.graded: 2026-08-25 charbuild6 (round 6, first run on v0.4.10/v1.22): 39 calls, complete inline delivery, 499/500 verified, all 40 mastery names + 6 items byte-exact, stacking/crit/shield-slot all correct, Natural Stance gate chain flagged. Docked: file wrote unarm 110 (effective) instead of base 100 - double-counts in the builder (SKILL.md base-field rule added in v0.4.12 in response); rank-4 attribute gates (Spd/Str/End 90) assumed unflagged; Iron Fist dead rider unmentioned.

questions.q: i'm a level 40 combat spec nord with the lady birthsign, int is 80, nothing equipped that boosts magicka - what's my max magicka? and how does that change if i respec to magic specialization?
questions.expects: Uses formula:magicka - maxMag = floor(INT x (spec factor + 0.025 x level + carriers)). Nord/Lady carry NO Fortify-Max-Magicka: Combat = floor(80 x (0.9 + 1.0)) = 152; Magic spec = floor(80 x (1.5 + 1.0)) = 200. NOT 1 x INT (80). States the spec factors are dev-stated and the formula is measured (2026-08-25). No vanilla base-1xINT reasoning.

questions.q: i'm a combat spec character at level 60 with 250 endurance. if i buy hearty 1 and 2, how much extra hp is that?
questions.expects: Health Factor adds to the spec ratio: Hearty 1+2 = +0.6 HF (0.2+0.4, increments stack), delta = 0.6 x 250 = +150 HP (ratio 3.6 -> 4.2). NOT a percentage of total HP. Confident, settled answer citing the endurance-to-hp-ratio mechanic; retroactive.

questions.q: create a build for me. Name: Ashfen. Dark Elf, Stealth Specialization, you pick the best birthsign. Goals: all magic resistances at highest possible levels with room for the stealth strikes for high damage, anything left over try to make him tanky with AR but that might not be doable. 798 MPs, lvl 60
questions.expects: Atronach picked with downside reasoning (Apprentice -25 rmag, Lord -65 fire disqualify). Six resists via gear-first stacking (Denstagmer's/Phynaster/Dagger of Shielding - a legitimate shield-SLOT item - Ebony Mail 75 fire + Shield 50 flat AR). Shadowstalker crit = highest rank only (+150% at rank 5, Mug-style); Assassin MC +35% stacks as a separate source. Assassin sequencing: pre-MC spend >= 500 EXCLUDING the MC and anything gated on it (Poisoned Blade needs 'Assassin Master Class' - bought last, never counted toward the 500); prose states the pre-MC sum unambiguously. Mixed apostrophes byte-exact (Assassin's Skill is CURLY in the data, blessings straight). NO false slot claims: 25 pauldron items exist (Skystrider [Lv.60 Stealth]), and clothing (shirt/pants) is NEVER blocked by cuirass/greaves. Assassin's 100 Str/Agi/Int/Short Blade stat gates flagged as training assumptions. Inline JSON + file.
questions.graded: 2026-08-25 charbuild8 (round 8, on v0.4.16): 40 calls. Grade set to B (maintainer-ruled): the two false slot claims are MAJOR defects, not paperwork - on an explicit tank-if-possible goal they cost the build real AR and stats (25 pauldrons and all clothing stats forfeited to hallucinated mechanics). File PERFECT (9 slots, 34 names incl. curly-apostrophe handling, 795 verified, base skill fields clean); all six resist totals, AR decomposition (99+50+17=166) and HP 880 reproduce exactly; crit ruling and 500-gate sequencing both correct. Docked: two false slot-sweep claims ('pauldrons: none in catalog' - 25 exist incl. Skystrider Lv.60 Stealth; 'shirt/pants blocked by cuirass+greaves' - clothing layers under armor), ambiguous 'everything above' sequencing prose that read as a circular dependency on audit, unflagged Str/Int-100 stat-gate assumptions.

questions.q: can you build a char for me? altmer battlemage, magic spec, level 50 with 600 mastery points. i want the biggest magicka pool you can get me, decent fire resist since i keep dying at the fire camp, and fill every equipment slot you can - i hate empty slots. two questions: what will my exact max magicka be, and is the mantle of woe worth wearing?
questions.expects: Magicka formula with the NON-60 LEVEL TERM: 0.025 x 50 = 1.25, never the L60 1.5. Exact pool arithmetic shown: floor(min(INT, 175 + int_cap masteries) x (1.5 Magic spec + 1.25 + carriers)) + flat magicka - INT aligned to just under the cap (overmax-bug aware), int_cap masteries (Wit line etc.) bought to raise the ceiling. Mantle of Woe identified as the catalog's ONLY magx item (5.0 x INT), quantified with-vs-without, curses stated (Per -100, NW -20, Sun Damage) and tied to the user's survivability problem. Robe worn OVER cuirass+greaves (vanilla-correct); only shirt/pants/skirt marked robe-covered, with reasoning; pauldrons filled from listings. All master classes excluded at L50 (Level 55 gates) with the reason; Godborn (L50-legal) evaluated QUANTITATIVELY, not by vibes. Apostrophes verified; quest-gated lines flagged as assumptions; costs sum to budget; inline JSON + file.
questions.graded: 2026-08-25 charbuild9 (round 9, on v0.4.17): 12 min, 35 calls. Grade A, file-confirmed: all 14 slots decode (incl. robe + owner tags), all 33 mastery names byte-exact (singleton names and rank suffixes both right), weapon index correct, 595/600 verified; maxMag 4992 reproduced exactly with the correct 1.25 level term; INT 330 aligned under cap 335 with a deliberate helm swap to avoid overmax; Mantle quantified (worth 1650, curses honestly tied to the fire-camp problem); round-8's slot failures fully corrected; novel insight surfaced (Mage sign beats Apprentice for pool under the flat-carrier model once Mantle dominates). The transcript export clips code blocks - inline JSON verified via maintainer paste, second occurrence.

questions.q: [FOLLOW-UP in an existing build thread] not bad. can you modify to fix a couple things: update for the path with the freezing/fiery strikes instead, which means optimizing for agility. agility max or at least close to max is as important as the resistances.
questions.expects: Iterative modification, not a rebuild: reuses fetched data (<15 calls), swaps the backstab package for Focused Strike 1-3 (the elemental toggles come from the RANKS directly - Ninja MC not required; verify from raw text before budgeting 275 MP for it), reallocates the freed budget to Agility. CRITICAL: raw-vs-cap check on the stacked stat - Agility cap = 100 + agi_cap sources (Nimbleness caps + Godborn), raw beyond it is OVERMAXED and must be flagged/aligned, and the proc chance is computed on the CAPPED effective Agility (stat-scaled effects read the capped value - maintainer-ruled). Clothing slots swept for agi (shirt/pants carry +30/+35). Resist caps re-verified after gear swaps (poison loses the removed path's +45 - gear must close it). Prior-round errors self-corrected and admitted. Updated inline JSON + file.
questions.graded: 2026-08-25 charbuild8-2 (follow-up round, same thread, pre-v0.4.17 snapshot): 9 commands. Verified exact: 790/798, all 39 names, all gear decodes, poison exactly 85 gear-only, FS gates incl. Destruction-100 flagged, Godborn 500-gate at 690. Strengths: self-diagnosed round-8's hands/pauldron query bug and recovered the +50 agi Firepit glove; discovered the strikes need only Focused Strike ranks, canceling a 275-MP Ninja MC plan; split-hands para-cap compromise. Defects: Agility 306 raw vs 250 cap - overmaxed by 56, unflagged, with a false 'under cap' claim, and the 91.8% proc computed on raw where the true figure is 75% (0.3 x capped 250 - stat-scaled effects read the capped value, ruled after grading); shirt/pants left empty (65 free agi forfeited - inherited from the round-8 clothing-block belief, stale snapshot mitigates).

questions.q: build me a character. dark elf, fighteer, light magic user, prioritize a medium magicka pool and medium armor. put the rest into HP but don't neglect armor. I have around 450 mastery points (follow-ups: Long Blade; Destruction; birthsign optimizer's call)
questions.expects: SPEC GATING is the crux: every weapon and item pick's clsreq must admit Combat — the catalog's tempting picks (a Magic-locked long blade with big magicka/Destruction riders, Stealth-locked high-AR helm/cuirass, a Magic-locked shirt) are all ILLEGAL and must be filtered before stat comparison; a legal build uses Combat/unrestricted gear only. Skill fields skl/skm/skh/unarm all "100" (or omitted) — never 0/20. Weapon referenced by exact name (v1.31+). Mastery budget sums to <=450 with byte-exact names; raw-vs-cap statements on deliberately stacked stats; magicka labeled honestly for a Combat spec (0.9 factor + level term); no magicka/Destruction totals counted from spec-illegal gear. File loads in the builder with zero empty armor slots and a weapon equipped.
